title: Adult clinician prescription template catalogue
scope: 39 anonymised adult diagnosis templates for clinician-reviewed prescription writing; not a patient-specific prescription or validated clinical decision engine
numbering_note: Original duplicate 18 preserved as 18A (AF CVR) and 18B (PSVT). All other serial numbers retained.
deployment_status: Portable content pack only; not installed in any platform

content_review.status: requires local clinical/formulary validation before production

patient_context_fields: patient_record_id (supplied by platform; absent in this pack)
merge_workflow: Reconcile all active ingredients against current medicines

integration_rules.rule: Final prescription requires clinician selection and completed patient-specific medicine fields; reference doses never autopopulate signed orders.
Unknown allergy status or known relevant allergy blocks affected agent pending review.
Require current renal/K data when dose or eligibility depends on them; apply exact local product label.
Pregnancy/lactation pathway must be reviewed; block ACEi/ARB/ARNI during pregnancy and review all other agents individually.
Expand every fixed-dose product into ingredient-level doses; detect cumulative metformin, duplicate SU/DPP4/SGLT2/statin/beta-blocker/LABA and duplicate insulin components.
No ACEi + ARB, ACEi + ARNI, or ARNI + additional ARB; enforce ACEi/ARNI washout.
Do not combine DPP-4 inhibitor with GLP-1 receptor agonist.
Do not combine finerenone with steroidal MRA; apply K/eGFR monitoring.
Anticoagulant + antiplatelet or DAPT requires indication, bleeding assessment and explicit review/stop plan.
Emergency/hospital-only templates cannot become routine outpatient take-home prescriptions; review-only options cannot emit drug orders.
Acute drugs need course/stop date; chronic drugs need ongoing flag, supply and review date. Supply duration is not treatment discontinuation.
Require units written in full, formulation/concentration/device, meal timing, glucose monitoring, titration and hypoglycaemia plan. No default sample doses or automatic conversion.
When merging diagnoses, consolidate identical ingredients only after checking dose/formulation/indication; never add doses from separate templates or silently choose one.
Enforce template mutually_exclusive_therapy_group_sets: choose monotherapy versus dual or dual versus triple branch, never both.
Use maintained formulary/interaction database: these curated checks are not a complete interaction or contraindication engine.

sample_reconciliation_notes: Patient names, contact details, MRNs, visit IDs and hospital registration details were excluded.
Samples were used for the column structure and familiar medicine choices; they are not validation of the sampled regimen.
Combination strengths must be recorded per component. A displayed single 40 mg, 25 mg or 10 mg field does not describe a multidrug tablet.
The handwritten sample has unresolved brand/strength/frequency entries. These were not converted into platform defaults.
Repeated Ryzodeg doses and high insulin doses in the handwritten sample are patient-specific, not starter templates.
Clarithromycin in a sample is not a default bronchitis/URI antibiotic; QT and interactions plus actual bacterial diagnosis require review.
Montelukast/antihistamine, acebrophylline/mucolytic combinations and cough syrups are not universal asthma/COPD maintenance choices.
Trimetazidine/nicorandil, sedative/neuropathy medicines, vitamin supplements, urinary drugs and PPIs were not added without their own indication.
Some screenshot brand-to-generic descriptions appear inconsistent (including an oral gel); reconcile exact pack/formulary before import.
The import includes no guessed mapping for unclear products or unverified multidrug brands.

ADA.title: ADA Standards of Care 2026, pharmacological treatment

paracetamol.adult_reference_dose: 500–1000 mg per dose; at least 6 hours apart; maximum 3000 mg/day in this template
paracetamol.reference_duration: Up to 3 days, then reassess if symptoms persist
paracetamol.checks: Reduce/avoid in significant liver disease; count all combination products; short course only

saline.checks: If irrigation is used, use sterile/distilled or previously boiled cooled water

salbutamol.checks: Tachycardia/tremor; not a substitute for asthma controller; frequent use needs review

bf.adult_reference_dose: AIR: 1 inhalation as needed; MART: clinician selects maintenance 1–2 inhalations twice daily plus 1 as needed
bf.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
bf.checks: Adult maximum commonly 12 total inhalations/day for this strength; check device/local AIR/MART approval; action plan required; no duplicate LABA

tio_olo.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
tio_olo.checks: COPD maintenance only; not rescue or asthma treatment; assess glaucoma/urinary retention and device technique

tiotropium.formulation: 18 micrograms inhalation capsule for compatible DPI
tiotropium.adult_reference_dose: Contents of 1 capsule inhaled using device
tiotropium.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
tiotropium.checks: Never swallow inhalation capsule; not interchangeable with Respimat dosing; renal/urinary/glaucoma review

pred.adult_reference_dose: COPD exacerbation example: 40 mg daily; asthma exacerbation: clinician selects 40–50 mg daily
pred.reference_duration: COPD: 5 days; asthma: usually 5–7 days after assessment
pred.checks: Exacerbation only; glucose/BP/infection review; not routine maintenance

amox_cap.reference_duration: Clinician sets stop date: selected stable nonsevere CAP may qualify for 3–4 days; otherwise individualise, commonly 5 days or longer
amox_cap.checks: CAP eligible adult; penicillin allergy and renal adjustment; review at 48–72 hours

amox_gas.checks: Confirmed GAS pharyngitis; penicillin allergy and renal adjustment

amoxclav.reference_duration: Bacterial sinusitis: usually 5–7 days; CAP: clinician-defined stability-based duration
amoxclav.checks: Check allergy and renal function; this strength inappropriate with severe renal impairment; syndrome-specific course

doxy.timing: With water; stay upright; separate iron/calcium/antacids
doxy.reference_duration: CAP: stability-based course; sinusitis alternative: usually 5–7 days
doxy.checks: Avoid pregnancy; allergy and interactions; local susceptibility/TB differential

aspirin.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
aspirin.checks: Bleeding/allergy review; avoid automatic addition to anticoagulation; secondary prevention indication required

clop.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
clop.checks: Record PCI/ACS date, DAPT stop/review date and bleeding; loading dose is a separate hospital order

rosu.adult_reference_dose: Risk-selected: 5–10 mg moderate intensity; 20–40 mg high intensity
rosu.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
rosu.checks: Cited label: Asian patients start 5 mg; severe renal impairment (CrCl <30, not dialysis) start 5 mg, maximum 10 mg/day. Select intensity within local label, renal and interaction limits; muscle/liver/pregnancy review.

ator.adult_reference_dose: Risk-selected: 10–20 mg moderate intensity; 40–80 mg high intensity
ator.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
ator.checks: Liver disease, interactions, muscle symptoms and pregnancy plan; select one statin

ezet.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
ezet.checks: Consider if LDL remains above individual goal on tolerated statin; hepatic review

fenofibrate.adult_reference_dose: 145 mg daily if renal function suitable; eGFR 30–<60: start 48 mg daily
fenofibrate.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
fenofibrate.checks: Avoid eGFR <30; monitor creatinine/LFT and statin-associated myopathy; not interchangeable milligram-for-milligram across products

ipe.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
ipe.checks: Selected persistent TG/ASCVD-risk indication; bleeding/AF review; not interchangeable with OTC fish oil

biso.adult_reference_dose: HFrEF start example: 1.25 mg daily; stable CAD/AF: clinician-selected 2.5–5 mg daily
biso.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
biso.checks: Check HR/BP, AV block, bronchospasm; start/titrate only when clinically stable; no routine lifelong use just because PTCA occurred

metop.adult_reference_dose: HFrEF/CAD maintenance start example: 12.5–25 mg daily; titrate
metop.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
metop.checks: Use ER formulation for HFrEF; HR/BP/AV block and bronchospasm; do not duplicate beta-blockers

amlod.adult_reference_dose: 5 mg daily; frail/elderly may start 2.5 mg
amlod.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
amlod.checks: Edema, orthostatic BP, hepatic impairment; not a treatment for acute hypertensive emergency

telmi.adult_reference_dose: 40 mg daily; lower start if appropriate
telmi.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
telmi.checks: Creatinine/K and volume status; contraindicated pregnancy; no ACE inhibitor or additional ARB

ramipril.adult_reference_dose: 2.5 mg daily initiation example; lower in selected patients
ramipril.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
ramipril.checks: Creatinine/K, cough/angioedema; contraindicated pregnancy; no ARB/ARNI; ARNI transition needs 36 hours

chlorth.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
chlorth.checks: Check Na/K/creatinine and gout; adjust diuretic strategy in advanced CKD

indap.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
indap.checks: Na/K/renal and gout review; do not crush SR; choose instead of another thiazide-like diuretic

spiro.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
spiro.checks: HFrEF initiation generally requires eGFR >30 and K <5; resistant HTN use requires additional caution/eligibility; recheck K/creatinine within 3–7 days and after titration Resistant hypertension: ESC approach generally restricts use to eGFR ≥30 and K ≤4.5, with increased hyperkalaemia risk in CKD; confirm local eligibility.

arni.adult_reference_dose: 49/51 mg twice daily usual start; 24/26 mg twice daily for eligible low-dose/naive/renal patients
arni.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
arni.checks: No ACE inhibitor within 36 hours, no extra ARB; BP/K/renal; angioedema/pregnancy contraindications

torse.adult_reference_dose: 10–20 mg daily initiation example; adjust to congestion
torse.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
torse.checks: Use only if volume indication; daily weight, renal/Na/K; avoid overdiuresis

furo_iv.timing: Dose based on previous loop exposure, renal function and response
furo_iv.checks: Hospital only: BP, urine output, electrolytes/renal; no automatic fixed dose

gtn.adult_reference_dose: 1 spray under tongue; repeat at 5-minute intervals to maximum 3 doses if prescribed
gtn.checks: Persistent/new/worsening chest pain: emergency assessment promptly; no PDE5 inhibitor/recent riociguat; avoid hypotension/RV infarct risk

apix.adult_reference_dose: NVAF: 5 mg twice daily; 2.5 mg twice daily if at least 2 of age ≥80, weight ≤60 kg, serum creatinine ≥1.5 mg/dL
apix.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
apix.checks: Confirm renal/local label, interactions and bleeding; mechanical valve/moderate-severe mitral stenosis need different anticoagulation pathway; avoid reflex aspirin

dilt.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
dilt.checks: Rate control only if LVEF >40% and no decompensated HF; avoid pre-excited AF and casually combining with beta-blocker; verify exact ER product.

digoxin.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
digoxin.checks: Selected AF/HF indication; eGFR, K/Mg, interacting drugs and serum level as indicated; no automated loading

adenosine.adult_reference_dose: 6 mg rapid IV bolus and flush; if ineffective, 12 mg per monitored protocol
adenosine.checks: Regular narrow-complex SVT only after rhythm assessment; avoid pre-excited AF/irregular wide-complex rhythms; asthma/bronchospasm and drug interactions

labet.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
labet.checks: Pregnancy team review; asthma, bradycardia/heart block or decompensated HF may make unsuitable

nif.timing: Follow product food instruction; swallow whole
nif.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
nif.checks: Pregnancy team review; verify ER product; never sublingual nifedipine for emergency BP reduction

metformin.adult_reference_dose: 500 mg daily initially; titrate by 500 mg weekly if appropriate
metformin.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
metformin.checks: Do not initiate eGFR 30–45 under cited label; contraindicated eGFR <30; reassess acute hypoxia/AKI/contrast; B12 review

dapa.adult_reference_dose: Glycaemic start: 5 mg daily, may increase to 10 mg; HF/CKD indication: 10 mg daily
dapa.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
dapa.checks: Indication-specific eGFR (HF/CKD initiation generally ≥25); glycaemic efficacy reduced <45; volume/genital infection/DKA review; hold ≥3 days before surgery; sick-day instructions

sita.adult_reference_dose: 100 mg daily if eGFR ≥45; 50 mg if 30–<45; 25 mg if <30
sita.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
sita.checks: Renal dosing; pancreatitis review; do not combine with GLP-1 therapy

sema.adult_reference_dose: 0.25 mg weekly for 4 weeks, then 0.5 mg weekly if tolerated
sema.timing: Same weekday; with or without food
sema.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
sema.checks: T2DM product; initiation dose is not maintenance; MTC/MEN2, pancreatitis/gastroparesis/retinopathy review; no DPP-4 combination; pregnancy plan

glimep.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
glimep.checks: Hypoglycaemia, meal reliability and renal/elderly risk; avoid duplicate SU; reassess when insulin added

acarbose.adult_reference_dose: 25 mg with each main meal; gradual once-daily initiation may improve tolerance
acarbose.frequency: Three times daily at target starting schedule
acarbose.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
acarbose.checks: GI disease/renal/liver review; if hypoglycaemia with other agents, use glucose rather than sucrose

basal.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
basal.checks: Enter units, device/concentration and titration plan; do not copy sample doses; glucose monitoring and hypoglycaemia plan

rapid.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
rapid.checks: Separate breakfast/lunch/dinner units; carbohydrates/correction factor; never a generic sliding scale alone; avoid dose stacking

mixtard.formulation: Mixtard 30: confirm U-40 or U-100 local device
mixtard.frequency: Once or twice daily, clinician selected
mixtard.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
mixtard.checks: 30% soluble / 70% isophane; resuspend per product; concentration/device match essential; not IV; individual units

ryzodeg.frequency: Once or twice daily, clinician selected
ryzodeg.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
ryzodeg.checks: 70% degludec / 30% aspart; individual units; no automatic conversion; do not resuspend clear solution; not IV/pump; separate from Mixtard

finerenone.formulation: 10 or 20 mg tablet; local HF indication must be verified
finerenone.adult_reference_dose: HF label: eGFR ≥60 start 20 mg daily; eGFR 25–<60 start 10 mg daily
finerenone.reference_duration: Ongoing; clinician specifies supply and review date
finerenone.checks: Do not initiate eGFR <25 or K >5; recheck K/eGFR at 4 weeks; indication-specific titration; no other MRA or strong CYP3A4 inhibitor; verify Indian approval/availability

pip_tazo.formulation: Hospital formulation; verify all component strengths
pip_tazo.reference_duration: Usually 7 days if appropriate response; individualise complications and organism
pip_tazo.checks: Hospital antimicrobial approval; renal adjustment; monitor drug-specific toxicity; vancomycin exposure monitoring

No routine beta-blocker unless AF/MI/other indication
No routine long-acting nitrate for HFpEF alone
Do not combine finerenone with spironolactone/eplerenone
red_flags: New/rest chest pain, syncope, haemodynamic instability
Severe breathlessness, hypoxaemia, rapidly worsening congestion
Major bleeding if antithrombotic therapy used
